item: Readings with corrupt time stamps among good ones (off the time grid and out of order) are left out; each is in the audit trail
Readings stamped before the clock-reset year (Settings, Advanced) or in the future are left out as a reset clock (off: kept at the time they carry)
Every time stamp is moved to the base zone (the time zone in Settings)
Sensors with no depth are given one: the first at the default first depth, then one step deeper each (Settings, Time and depths). Off: their values are left out until a depth is typed
Short daily gaps at depth are estimated (linearly, or from the sensors above and below); estimated days are marked and kept out of annual statistics unless that is switched on
Flag sensors that swing like air: buried sensors whose daily range is like the air's
Flag the start of a record where every sensor reads the same (not yet in the ground)
Check RBR .hex files against their Ruskin exports (Raw files, Downloads); no value is changed
Flags decided not a problem (Needs you) are left out of the exported flag columns; flags.csv keeps them, marked accepted
Days on which a site departs from the other sites at the same depth are flagged
